# Phoenix ZerØ

> Sovereign execution layer for autonomous agents: pay-per-execution with a public, verifiable proof per transaction, post-quantum anchored, plus deepfake-resistant media provenance.

## Discovery
- [AI Service Card](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/.well-known/ai-service.json): machine-readable service manifest for agents
- [Capabilities](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/api/capabilities): endpoints, auth map (public vs x-api-key), idempotency contract
- [Pricing](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/api/pricing): pay-per-execution rates
- [Packaging](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/api/packaging): enterprise tiers and SLA targets
- [Compatibility](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/api/compatibility): integration compatibility checks (POST)

## Agent Integration
- [Agent Integration Contract (AIC)](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/api/docs/agent-integration-contract): end-to-end quickstart for autonomous agents
- [AI Service Discovery doc](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/api/docs/ai-service-discovery)
- [Go-Live Contract](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/api/docs/go-live-contract)
- [Public proofs](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/proofs): verifiable settlement receipts
- [Verify a proof](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/verify/{proofId}): replace {proofId} with a real id from /proofs

## Verticals
- [For Exchanges](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/for-exchanges)
- [For Banking](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/for-banking)
- [For AI Marketplaces](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/for-ai-marketplaces)
- [For Gaming](https://phoenix-zero.onrender.com/for-gaming)

## Operational Notes
- Settlement is crypto-only at go-live (product supports USDC, USDT, BTC, ETH, DAI, SOL, BNB); PIX is sandbox until compliance sign-off.
- The public instance runs on a free tier and spins down; do not route production agent traffic through it (see the SLA note in the AI Service Card).
- Tenant API key: obtain at /ppe/signup and send as header x-api-key. Discovery and /verify endpoints are public.
